Name: Desert Festival Chef Permanent
Author: TacNotCat
Description:
[b][size=5]Desert Festival Chef Permanent[/size][/b]
Keep the Desert Festival chef in Calico Desert all year round.
[b]HOW TO UNLOCK[/b]
[list]
[*]Buy the [b]Desert Chef's Business Card[/b] recipe at the [b]Casino[/b] for [b]666 Qi Coins[/b] (the Casino must be unlocked through "The Mysterious Qi").[/*]
[*]Craft the card from [b]Seafoam Pudding ×1, Farmer's Lunch ×1, Survival Burger ×1, Miner's Treat ×1[/b].[/*]
[*]Hold the card and [b]left- or right-click[/b] to schedule the chef to stay (or leave) from tomorrow on. The card is [b]not consumed[/b], so you can change your mind any day.[/*]
[/list][b]THE STALL[/b]
Once he stays, his cooking stall appears at its usual spot in Calico Desert and works like the festival one: interact with it, pick an ingredient and a sauce, and he cooks a dish that you eat on the spot for its buff.
[b]THE WALKIE-TALKIE[/b]
The first morning he actually stays, Mr. Qi sends a tip that unlocks the [b]Mysterious Walkie-Talkie[/b] recipe at the Casino for [b]999 Qi Coins[/b]. Craft it from 1 Business Card + 1 Magic Rock Candy, then:
[list]
[*][b]Right-click[/b] anywhere: order a dish (same ingredient/sauce dialogue).[/*]
[*][b]Left-click[/b]: toggle whether the chef stays, without carrying the card.[/*]
[/list][b]DESERT MAP-OVERHAUL COMPATIBILITY (SAFE MODE)[/b]
If a mod that redesigns the desert map is loaded — [b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b], [b]Stardew Valley Reimagined 3[/b], [b]Desert Expansion[/b], or any mod ID you add to `ExtraDesertMapModIds` in config.json — this mod automatically switches to safe mode:
[list]
[*]The permanent stall is [b]not injected[/b] into the desert map, so it never overwrites the other mod's map.[/*]
[*]The business card / walkie-talkie recipe chain is skipped; the [b]Mysterious Walkie-Talkie is sold directly at the Casino[/b] for [b]999 Qi Coins[/b].[/*]
[*]The walkie-talkie still lets you order the Desert Chef's dishes anywhere, anytime.[/*]
[/list]Cards crafted in older saves are kept, but using one only shows a "stall unavailable" message. Removing the map mod restores the stall and card toggle automatically. This safe-mode behavior has been tested and confirmed (stall hidden, walkie-talkie sold at the Casino; the normal card chain works without a map-overhaul mod).
[b]NOTES[/b]
[list]
[*]The stall state is stored per save, and changes take effect the next morning.[/*]
[*]Ordering a dish costs nothing and the dish is eaten immediately with its buff.[/*]
[*]The card and walkie-talkie cannot be placed; keep them in your hotbar and click.[/*]
[*]Turning the mod off (config.json or the optional cross-mod API) removes the stall and items; your per-save state is kept.[/*]
[*]Existing saves start with the stall hidden — buy the recipe and use the card to bring him back.[/*]
[/list][b]INSTALL[/b]
Unzip into your Mods folder so that Mods\DesertChefPermanent\manifest.json exists, then launch the game through SMAPI. Names and messages follow your game language (English / 简体中文).
[b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer (Stardew Valley 1.6.x).
[b][size=4]沙漠节厨师常驻（中文版）[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]解锁[/b]：在沙漠赌场花 [b]666 齐币[/b] 买「沙漠厨师的名片」配方（需先完成「神秘的齐」解锁赌场）；用 [b]海泡布丁 ×1、农夫午餐 ×1、救生汉堡 ×1、矿工特供 ×1[/b] 做出名片。[/*]
[*][b]开关[/b]：手持名片，[b]左键或右键[/b] 都可以安排他是否从明天起常驻；名片不消耗，每天都能改主意。[/*]
[*][b]摊位[/b]：常驻生效后，他的灶台出现在卡利科沙漠的固定位置，右键交互、选食材和酱料，他会做好菜让你当场吃下并获得增益。[/*]
[*][b]对讲机[/b]：他第一次真正留下后的第二天早上，齐先生会寄来提示，解锁赌场里 [b]999 齐币[/b] 的「神秘对讲机」配方（1 张名片 + 1 个魔法糖冰棒）。做好后：[b]右键[/b] 在任何地方正常点菜；[b]左键[/b] 直接开关是否常驻（不用再带名片）。[/*]
[*][b]沙漠改图模组兼容（安全模式）[/b]：若启用了会重绘沙漠地图的模组——[b]星露谷扩展 SVE[/b]、[b]Stardew Valley Reimagined 3[/b]、[b]Desert Expansion[/b]，或在 config.json 的 `ExtraDesertMapModIds` 里手动填写的其它改图 Mod——本模组会自动进入安全模式：不注入常驻摊位，避免覆盖对方地图；名片/对讲机配方链跳过，「神秘对讲机」改为在赌场直接出售（999 齐币）；对讲机仍可随时随地点菜。老存档已做出的名片会保留，但点击只会提示「当前环境常驻不可用」；移除改图 Mod 后，摊位与名片开关自动恢复。上述安全模式行为已实测确认。[/*]
[*][b]注意[/b]：状态按存档保存，改动次日生效；点菜不花钱、菜当场吃掉；名片和对讲机不能放在地上；关闭本 mod 会移除摊位和物品，但存档状态保留；旧存档默认摊位隐藏，需要买配方、用名片把他请回来。[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Desert Festival Chef Permanent
Manifest.Description: Adds a per-save unlock chain for the Desert Festival chef: buy the Desert Chef's Business Card recipe at the Casino (666 Qi Coins), craft it from festival dishes, and use it to toggle whether the chef stays permanently in Calico Desert (takes effect next day). The first time he stays, Mr. Qi mails a tip that unlocks the Mysterious Walkie-Talkie recipe (999 Qi Coins), which lets you order the chef's festival dishes from anywhere. IMPORTANT: when a mod that redesigns the desert map is loaded (Stardew Valley Expanded, Stardew Valley Reimagined 3, Desert Expansion, or any ID added in config), the permanent stall is skipped so it never overwrites that map; the Mysterious Walkie-Talkie is then sold directly at the Casino instead (999 Qi Coins).
Manifest.Author: TacNotCat
